items.name: PSI DRS4 V5 · 5.12 GS/s
items.description: Standard V5 board, internal reference clock. PSI software request 5 GS/s selects divider 12, giving a programmed nominal rate of 5.12 GS/s and a 200 ns circular window. A real timing calibration may differ. Two-channel 50 Ω, centred 1 V range. The manual describes AC coupling; its unknown low-frequency transfer is omitted for these short pulses. 30 µs is the nominal chip-level parallel full-readout model requested for this configuration, excluding USB and board multiplexing/firmware overhead. It is not a measured sustained V5 board throughput. The cell-time model is a conditional statistical fit, not a measured calibration. Bandwidth is a single-pole approximation.

references.title: PSI DRS4 Evaluation Board v5 manual
references.comment: Four 50 Ω inputs, 1024 cells, 14-bit ADC, 1 V range and 700 MHz bandwidth.

references.title: PSI DRS4 datasheet rev. 0.9 — Full Readout Mode
references.comment: Nominal 30 µs parallel full-chip readout, independent of domino sampling frequency. Selected chip-level model without USB transfer as requested; not the end-to-end V5 board latency. Multiplexing, firmware and host transport add overhead.

references.title: PSI DRS4 software 5.0.5 — frequency selection
references.comment: Osci.cpp:1084–1104: normal request range 0.7–5 GS/s; 0.5 only for modified boards 2146/2205/2208. DOFrame.cpp:1620–1631 clamps requests. DRS.cpp:647–650 and 2696–2709: reference 60 MHz, divider = floor(61.44/request + 0.5), nominal rate = 61.44/divider. This entry: request 5, divider 12, nominal rate 5.12 GS/s, window 200 ns. GetTrueFrequency uses calibrated cell widths when available; this simulation has no measured board calibration. Download index: https://www.psi.ch/en/ltp-muon-physics/software-download .

references.title: D. Petschke, doctoral thesis (2020)
references.comment: pp.22–23 Fig.13: measured interval distribution at 5.12 GS/s. Two Gaussian lobes: 137.0/255.4 ps with sigma 23.7/22.0 ps. Use an assumed fixed coordinate sigma of 10 ps. The fitted random coordinate sigma is sqrt((23.7²+22²)/4 − 10²) = 12.7052 ps; the symmetric model approximates both lobes with sigma 22.8658 ps. Even/odd interval offset is ±59.2 ps. Centres are recentered to nominal 195.3125 ps, giving 136.1125/254.5125 ps. Conditional fit, not an independently measured random jitter. The three cell parameters scale by 5.12/programmed rate at other rates (assumption). Noise 0.48 mV and channel IRF 2.5 ps remain separate model values.

references.title: Stricker-Shaver, Ritt & Pichler (2014), Section VI
references.comment: Alternating short/long intervals persist at lower rates; timing performance degrades approximately inversely with sampling frequency. TwinPALS scales all coordinate-jitter parameters by 5.12/rate. This is a phenomenological extrapolation, not a published calibration at those rates. Author manuscript: https://arxiv.org/abs/1405.4975. Separate channel IRF is not scaled.
